Jordan: Heads-up  Zephyr flagged FedRAMP blockers; can we repurpose today's 1pm office hour for a focused session?
Priya: What time do they need? 1pm still works for most of us.
Jordan: They prefer earlier for EMEA security folks. Suggested 11am PT.
Noor: I can swap my 1pm slot to 11. Need scrubbed demo data and a 1-page checklist.
Ben: I'll handle the scrub and snapshot. Link to scrub runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub. Need 25m.
Priya: @cs_scheduler_bot create 11:00 PT invite titled "Zephyr FedRAMP quick sync" and add Zephyr_CISO + infra alias.
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event...  Done. https://cal.redwood.com/event/zephyr-fedramp-1742129999 (11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC). Reminders set.
Jordan: Draft agenda: 11:00 intro (Jordan), 11:05 demo (Noor), 11:20 compliance Q&A (Priya), 11:35 next steps (Ben) - 40m total.
Noor: Demo will show Hosted baseline + notes on Dedicated isolation. Will need 2 extra mins.
Priya: I'll prepare the FedRAMP checklist and drop in chat. Also prepping 2-question pulse for post-call.
Ben: Sandbox snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/zephyr-snap-1742129999. PII scrub v2 applied.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Ben. Invites resent.
Zephyr_CISO: (external) Confirmed 11:00. Thanks for moving quickly.
Jordan: Who owns follow-ups & health doc update? We should capture any renewal risk signals.
Ben: I'll own follow-ups and tag AEs if they surface on-prem asks.
Noor: I'll record demo and share clip timestamps.
Priya: Pre-call: let's do a 10:30 quick sync for handoffs. I'll DM calendar.
Jordan: Perfect. See you all at 10:30. :thumbsup:
